Mumbai BMC Launches AI Health Chatbot on WhatsApp

The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has launched a new health chatbot on WhatsApp, powered by AI technology from Fractals Vaidya.ai. The chatbot aims to provide health information to citizens via the messaging platform. This initiative integrates artificial intelligence into public health services, making health information more accessible to the residents of Mumbai.
